answer: An agent proves it belongs to a vetted set without naming which member it is. One registry holds an accumulator of approved commitments, and each agent submits a zero-knowledge proof of membership plus a fresh nullifier tied to the epoch seed, so one entry answers once per epoch. Joining costs a 1,000 POA bond, refundable after ten clean epochs, so 10,000 fakes lock 10 million POA for months, and a caught commitment is deleted from the accumulator. Like an ocean hiding every fish while the oasis guard still spots a real swimmer, as a zephyr of fresh nullifiers keeps each proof unique.
